Theme

keep watch verb

also watch, keep an eye on, keep an eye on that guy, keep one’s eyes on

classical

vigilō, vigilāre

verb, first conjugation · Conjugation on Wiktionary

Other words

  • adservō (asservō), adservāre, adservāvī, adservātum — keep an eye on, watch, guard

    verb, first conjugation · also used · classical · Plaut. Men. 2.2.75: adservātōte haec; Cic. Arch. 5 (Lewis & Short s.v. asservō); Traupman 97; Traupman 312 · Conjugation on Wiktionary

Examples

  • Quis venit? Vidēsne aliquem, tata? — Nēminem videō.

    Who’s coming? Can you see anyone, Dad? — I can’t see anyone.Libellus II, Sintra: castellum et puteus

  • Adservā istum!

    Keep an eye on that guy!Traupman 97

  • oculōs intentāre in (+ acc.)

    to keep one’s eyes onTraupman 336

See also guard, enemy.
